==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}
Elayne arrives at a hill about a thousand paces to the northwest of Caemlyn. She realizes, whilst observing at the damage, that warfare has changed forever with the introduction of the [[Dragons]]. [[Perrin Aybara|Perrin]] and the [[Children of the Light|Whitecloaks]] arrive too. The battle plan is to lure the [[Trolloc|Trollocs]] out of the city and into the forest where they can fight them more successfully. [[Davram t'Ghaline Bashere|Bashere]] argues with Elayne about whether she should tell the men she carries the children of the [[Dragon Reborn]]. Using [[gateways]] the army of Light fills some of the basements in the city with oil and set them on fire. Watching the burning city, Elayne orders [[Birgitte Silverbow|Birgitte]] to make it known among the [[Queen's Guards|Guards]] the children she carries are [[Rand al'Thor]]'s.

:{{pov|[[Androl Genhald]]}}
Androl, [[Jonneth Dowtry|Jonneth]], and [[Algarin Pendaloan|Emarin]] are laying down, tied to hooks in the ground and shielded. [[Pevara Tazanovni|Pevara]] and [[Evin Vinchova|Evin]] are also tied up and shielded. Evin tells Androl that [[Mazrim Taim|Taim's]] men broke him and learned of Androl's plan when they came looking for Emarin. Pevara tells Androl telepathically that they were dug out of the dirt room because Taim hasn't met his quota of [[Turning|Turned]] [[Dreadlords]] yet. Evin is Turned and tells Androl that [[Arlen Nalaam|Nalaam]] died in the cave-in. Emarin is taken to be Turned next by 13 [[Myrddraal]] and Androl thinks that Nalaam was lucky to have died in the cave-in.
